high_mass_engine_evidence.interpretation: Positive and zero explosion-energy outcomes alternate across the 40--120 Msun tail and between engine branches; no universal ZAMS mass cut is inferred.

mass_budget_review.limitation: The Z9.6 review bound is not applied to high-mass W18/N20 records; implosion-wind-only records have no terminal mass cut for this comparison.
mass_budget_review.scope: available W18/N20 high-mass yield tables only

mass_budget_review.comparison: stable ejecta plus stable wind versus labelled ZAMS mass minus P-HOTB baryonic mass cut
mass_budget_review.limitation: Tables are rounded to three significant figures and expose only 20 selected radioactive isotopes; this is not an exact complete-isotope closure identity.
mass_budget_review.scope: Z9.6 engine, source-labelled solar, 9--12 Msun review grid
